children: Long-term Japanese government bond yields rise, driven by concerns about higher prices of energy and other products. A rise in domestic yields has come after escalating fears over energy prices and inflation drove the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield above 5% overnight. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East ahead of the Fed and Bank of Japan policy meetings later this week. The 10-year JGB yield is 1.5 basis points higher at 3.000%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
